body: OK, I have repro'd this bug and it's a real one.   I think the problem is that the word "None" isn't getting translated into the None object.

I also have encountered this problem and it prevents my app from starting. Tried the following 4 combinations:
 * `streamlit run --server.fileWatcherType=none my_app.py`
 * `streamlit run --server.fileWatcherType=poll my_app.py`
 * `STREAMLIT_SERVER_FILE_WATCHER_TYPE=none streamlit run my_app.py`
 * `STREAMLIT_SERVER_FILE_WATCHER_TYPE=poll streamlit run my_app.py`

They all give this error:

```python
OSError: [Errno 28] inotify watch limit reached
```

From this traceback it is evident that [config.get_option()](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/de447b7b2028585b1055b7194b8f85bac30c0768/lib/streamlit/config.py#L91) invoked by [file_watcher.get_default_file_watcher_class()](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/de447b7b2028585b1055b7194b8f85bac30c0768/lib/streamlit/watcher/file_watcher.py#L103) returns value that does not take into account options passed by command line and options passed by environment variables.

The result is that [file_watcher.get_default_file_watcher_class()](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/de447b7b2028585b1055b7194b8f85bac30c0768/lib/streamlit/watcher/file_watcher.py#L103) always returns [EventBasedFileWatcher](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/de447b7b2028585b1055b7194b8f85bac30c0768/lib/streamlit/watcher/event_based_file_watcher.py#L53).

My first guess would be to see whether `LocalSourcesWatcher` is created before or after the options passed by command line and environment variables are reflected in [config._config_options](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/de447b7b2028585b1055b7194b8f85bac30c0768/lib/streamlit/config.py#L56), which is [indirectly accessed by](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/de447b7b2028585b1055b7194b8f85bac30c0768/lib/streamlit/config.py#L1052) `config.get_option()`.

issue.title: Don't allow config.get_option to be called on file import

repository.name: streamlit
repository.description: Streamlit — A faster way to build and share data apps.

issue.body:
This makes some things harder to write, but it's necessary because
otherwise, config options that are accessed on file import may ignore
options set via flag or environment variable (as those haven't been parsed
yet). Thankfully, there are only two places where code had to be reworked,
and both of these changes were relatively straightforward.

To prevent this from accidentally happening in the future, we added an
assertion in conftest.py that explodes if config options have been
populated after importing streamlit.

Closes #2257
Closes #2989 
Closes #2990

body: Thanks for bumping this @franekp. Coincidentally, I'm about to merge a PR fixing this (#3235). The fix should be included in 0.83 (which unfortunately isn't the release going out tomorrow), so it should land in a few weeks time.
@vdonato Thanks a lot for fixing this!

after some time i get a similar error too. version 0.83.0
```
 raise OSError(errno.ENOSPC, "inotify watch limit reached")  
OSError: [Errno 28] inotify watch limit reached
```

`fs.inotify.max_user_instances` doesn't help.
so, this commands `echo fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288 | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.conf && sudo sysctl -p` helped
using "--server.fileWatcherType=none" while launching the app, solved the issue.
